label: Electric piano, reed, sampled, close and dry
audition_title: libsonare electric piano 2 vs the sampled reference
_notes: Every sixth semitone from 36 to 84, the compass a keyboard voice is probed on here, because the compass is the point of a keyboard and a physical model diverges most at the ends of it. Both ends were rendered before the grid was written and both speak, the peaks running 0.187, 0.187, 0.162 at 36, 60 and 84.
_velocities: Five. On a struck string velocity is the hammer, so it moves the partial stack as much as the level: on this slot velocity 32 sits -20.2 dB under velocity 100 at middle C. The softest row is kept because it is the most distinct timbre the instrument has.
_dry: Nothing to switch off, measured rather than assumed. Not one of the plugin's advertised parameters matches `reverb` with this rack loaded, and the render agrees: what follows the strike is the instrument's own fall with no room behind it.
_stimulus: A struck string is damped by the key rather than stopped by running out, so the fall the model has to match happens while the key is still down: long gate, short tail. This slot is -21 dBFS a quarter of a second in and -62 at eight seconds, still falling when the key lifts, and it is at the numerical floor a fifth of a second after that. Eight seconds of gate contains the fall and half a second of tail contains the damping.
_calibration: From `capture.py calibrate` on this rack, and this is the rack where running it mattered: at a two-second settle its slots render silence or a note arriving seconds late, while at eight the same note renders the same peak three times running with the onset on the preroll. A probe taken at the shorter settle read a neighbouring slot eighteen decibels quiet.
_timbres: One, and the ladder is monotone above it, so this capture cannot move the voice past `voiced` however complete its coverage. The rack holds one slot per GM program, so there is no second of this instrument in it to disagree with. What the reference buys is a measured target for `autofit` and `--diagnose` where the voice could previously only be fitted by ear.
_dimensions: The slot is a struck metal reed read by a pickup. A struck string is measured on everything its class names - it has a free decay, a two-stage fall, a damper and a dynamic range, and the stiff-string ladder means something - so `decay` and its two stages carry the weight here, read off a gate long enough to contain a fall.
_dimensions_na: The exclusions as data, since a dimension argued only in prose reads as a gap. Coverage is read against `toneclass.canonical_dimensions`, which for a struck string is every melodic dimension, so anything not gated here has to be argued here.

dimensions_na.stereo: the slot renders dual mono: the two channels are bit-identical, so the width is zero by construction rather than by voicing

_identity: Which product this is captured from lives in the untracked sibling `electric_piano_2.local.json`. Everything here is the method; scoring, fitting and diagnosing read `reference/electric_piano_2.json`.
_slots: Slot identity is measured, never taken from a name or a position. The rack is addressed by MIDI channel; this program answers on channel 6, and it was rendered at its own three probe notes before anything else was written, reading 0.987 of its energy on the played key's series. The same renders are what say the slot rings: three acoustic-piano slots of this rack are at the numerical floor a second after the strike and are not captured, while this one is still falling at eight.
